explication: NGINX Gateway Fabric implements Kubernetes Gateway API resources and turns them into an NGINX load-balancing, reverse-proxy, or API-gateway dataplane. The principal flow is Kubernetes resource events → controller reconciliation → graph construction and validation → NGINX configuration generation → NGINX Agent deployment. Policy generation, WAF bundle polling, status updates, and telemetry/metrics are supporting branches. The tree and excerpts establish registration, event dispatch, provisioning, graph service resolution, and WAF polling; some cross-package calls are therefore shown conservatively.
